main_body: three-story brick campus building with flat concrete roof
top_band: grey concrete flat roof with parapet rim and rooftop vents from row 1 to row 40
evidence: Rows 1-40 show a clear foreshortened flat roof surface with parapet walls, inner shadow (rows 3-5), tiled concrete slabs, and 3/4 rooftop vents. Row 38-39 is a bright front parapet edge, followed by a cornice (rows 41-45) and eave shadow (row 46) above the 3-story brick front facade (rows 41-143) with recessed windows and arched double doors.

style.evidence: The building features rich individual brick coursework with 4-5 value steps of reddish-brown, cream stonework with corbel shadows, speckled concrete roof slabs, and multi-tone window panes with diagonal reflections. Outlines and separators use deep material tones rather than flat black.
